regime: Forced selling in metals alongside a tech-led selloff, with silver under extra stress and miners lagging gold
takeaway: Gold slipped about 0.7% to near $3,856, about 7.4% below a month ago, while silver fell about 3.6% to a 52-week low near $46.90, pushing the gold/silver ratio up to about 82. Gold miners fell much harder than gold (GDX −3.3%), and the Nasdaq dropped 2.5% as Nvidia and chip stocks slid, sending the VIX up nearly 19% to about 22.9. Treasury yields eased and oil fell about 3.5%, but the dollar hit its highest close since April 2025 as markets still price a December Fed hike.
